<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X) / 2 and the molecular formula C7H12NO (C=7, H=12, N=1, X=0), the calculation yields (14 + 2 + 1 − 12)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, we take the nearest whole number, which is 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
